title: carryoverTodos is an observation LOG being used as a work QUEUE — 764 items, size set by inflow x TTL, not by work remaining
summary: MEASURED 2026-08-27 on .evolve/state.json. 764 carryoverTodos, all distinct (no duplicates), almost disjoint from the inbox (only 4 of 94 inbox ids overlap), so this is a separate auto-generated universe rather than a view of the curated queue. Composition: 640 named work items (84%) + 124 failure breadcrumbs (116 cycle-N-failed-audit, 8 failed-build). THE ARITHMETIC: each cycle EMITS 4.8 carryover todos (measured over 25 cycles) at 8.1 cycles/day = ~39/day inflow. Outflow: triage picks 1.1/cycle into top_n and DROPS only 0.4/cycle (measured over 20 cycles); everything else is deferred, which by design survives. The only other removal is a 30-day TTL (failurelog.DefaultCarryoverBackfillTTL). So steady state ~= inflow x TTL ~= 39 x 30 ~= 1,170 — the observed 764 is that equilibrium, NOT a measure of work remaining. Net per cycle: +4.8 in, -1.5 out. The queue would sit near a thousand forever no matter how much work got done. ROOT TENSION (deliberate, documented): retireTriageDroppedCarryover retires ONLY triage's explicit `dropped` set, with the comment 'Forgetting a live todo is worse than carrying a stale one, so every ambiguous case keeps the todo.' That retention bias is defensible per-item and catastrophic in aggregate at 4.8 in / 0.4 dropped. Mean cycles_unpicked is 48.7 (max 126) — the average item has been passed over ~49 times and will age out unread. Three writers feed it: memo/retro observations (carryover_merge.go), audit WARN prescriptions (prescription_carryover.go), and failure records (failure_learning.go). ALSO: one immortal item, cycle-1063-failed-build, has expiresAt 2058-03-30 (32 years out) and 126 cycles_unpicked — a TTL computation bug that exempts it from the only working eviction path. SUGGESTED DIRECTION: (a) stop treating the observation log as the selection pool — select from the curated inbox and keep carryover as evidence; (b) cap the log (top-N by priority, or bounded ring) so it cannot exceed what triage can plausibly read; (c) make emission cost something — an audit prescription that nobody picks in N cycles should retire itself rather than wait 30 days; (d) fix the 2058 expiry.
